summary.en: Give a repeated job a name, call it with inputs, and follow control back to its caller.
summary.bn: একই কাজ বারবার লিখতে হয় না; ফাংশন বানিয়ে নাম ধরে ডাকলেই কাজটি হয়।

notes: Function definitions and prototypes exist in C89; these examples use C99-style local declarations.

sections.title: A name for a useful job
Read the parts of a function
Start with one action, then combine calls
Distinguish a definition from a call

examples.title: A welcome used twice
examples.explanationHtml: Both calls print the same greeting. After the first call returns, main reaches the second call.

examples.title: Calculate two photocopy bills
examples.explanationHtml: The two page counts produce 36 and 21 taka. Each call uses a separate pages value.

examples.title: Follow a nested call
examples.explanationHtml: The line function finishes before report ends. Only then can main print its final message.

examples.title: Combine a library call and a helper
examples.explanationHtml: The user-defined helper calls abs from the C library. The chosen value is far from the INT_MIN exception.

practice.title: Tickets for one lab visit
practice.statementHtml: Read a ticket count from 0 to 100. Use a function that returns count times 15. Print the prompt Tickets: followed by Cost = N on the next output line.
hints: Keep the price rule inside ticket_cost.

practice.title: A named separator
practice.statementHtml: Read a width from 1 to 30. Call a void function that prints that many equals signs and a newline. Print Width: before reading.
hints: Let the helper own the loop and newline.

practice.title: Compare two square areas
practice.statementHtml: Read two side lengths from 0 to 100. Call square_area for each. Print Sides: before input, then the two integer areas separated by one space.
hints: Call the same helper with different arguments.

practice.title: Build a result report
practice.statementHtml: Read marks from 0 to 100. main calls report, which calls passed. Print Marks: before input, then Pass for at least 40 or Retry otherwise.
hints: passed should return a truth value; report chooses the message.

quiz.prompt: What starts the execution of a user-defined function body?
options: A prototype ending with a semicolon
Writing its name in a comment
quiz.explanation: A definition describes the job. A call transfers control to perform that job.

quiz.prompt: Which header declares the library function abs for int values?
quiz.explanation: abs is the integer-magnitude function from stdlib.h; fabs is the floating function from math.h.

quiz.prompt: Two calls use different page counts. Which costs are printed?
quiz.explanation: The inputs are independent: four pages cost twelve, and six cost eighteen.

quiz.prompt: Why put a photocopy price rule in one helper?
options: Each call automatically saves the previous page count
Several callers can reuse one calculation
quiz.explanation: One implementation avoids repeating a price formula. Bounds and input checks still need a design.

quiz.prompt: In int copy_cost(int pages), what does the first int describe?
quiz.explanation: The type before the name describes the value produced by a call.

quiz.prompt: A helper prints between two main messages. In which order do the letters appear?
quiz.explanation: main pauses at show, which prints B before main continues to C.

quiz.prompt: When report calls line, which call resumes immediately after line returns?
quiz.explanation: The directly waiting caller resumes. main remains waiting until report also returns.

quiz.prompt: Which declaration describes an action with no arguments and no result value?
quiz.explanation: The first void describes the result, while void inside parentheses describes the empty parameter list.

quiz.prompt: The returned lab fee initializes total. Which total is displayed?
quiz.explanation: fee returns sixty; the caller then adds five.

quiz.prompt: What belongs to each ordinary active call rather than being shared automatically?
quiz.explanation: Automatic locals belong to separate call instances. Static-duration objects have different persistence rules.

keyPoints.en: A function groups statements under a name.
keyPoints.bn: ফাংশন একটি নামের অধীনে কয়েকটি কাজ রাখে।

keyPoints.en: A call pauses its caller until the called function finishes.
keyPoints.bn: ডাকা ফাংশন শেষ হওয়া পর্যন্ত কলারের কাজ থেমে থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Library functions come with declared interfaces in headers.
keyPoints.bn: লাইব্রেরি ফাংশনের ঘোষণা হেডারে পাওয়া যায়।

keyPoints.en: Each active call has its own automatic local variables.
keyPoints.bn: চলমান প্রতিটি কলে নিজের লোকাল ভেরিয়েবল থাকে।

keyPoints.en: A return expression supplies a value to the caller.
keyPoints.bn: return-এর এক্সপ্রেশন কলারকে একটি মান দেয়।

examQuestions.question: Explain the difference between defining a price helper and calling it twice.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A definition supplies the named body and interface once. Each call runs that body with its own argument values and returns to its caller. Defining the helper alone performs no price calculation.

#include <stdio.h>

int cost(int pages)
{
    return pages * 3;
}

int main(void)
{
    printf("%d %d\n", cost(4), cost(6));
    return 0;
}

12 18

The inputs are independent: four pages cost twelve, and six cost eighteen.

examQuestions.question: Read marks from 0 to 100. main calls report, which calls passed. Print Marks: before input, then Pass for at least 40 or Retry otherwise.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int passed(int mark)
{
    return mark >= 40;
}

void report(int mark)
{
    puts(passed(mark) ? "Pass" : "Retry");
}

int main(void)
{
    int mark;
    puts("Marks:");
    if (scanf("%d", &mark) != 1 || mark < 0 || mark > 100) {
        return 1;
    }
    report(mark);
    return 0;
}

passed should return a truth value; report chooses the message.

For input 39, the program prints:

Marks:
Retry
